title.zh: Metaplanet 通过注入 2,100 BTC 及现金获 Super League 控股权，登陆纳斯达克
title.en: ⚡️Metaplanet获批控股纳斯达克上市公司SLE，成功实现在美上市布局

current_state.zh:
Metaplanet 创始人兼 CEO Simon Gerovich 于 10 月 19 日宣布，其与纳斯达克上市公司 Super League Enterprise（SLE）的交易已在该公司股东大会上获得正式批准。Metaplanet 将注入 2,100 枚比特币及 250 万美元现金（总值约 1.346 亿美元），换取约 4486 万股、每股 3 美元的新发行普通股以及优先股和认股权证，从而取得 SLE 的控股权。

Gerovich 表示，交易完成后该公司将作为 Metaplanet 在美国上市的比特币财库平台，使其能够直接接入美国资本市场并获得更灵活的融资能力。结合在日本设立的 Metaplanet Securities，此次获批将使公司在全球两大资本市场上拥有互补性平台。

据 BlockBeats，Metaplanet 将持有 SLE 约 95.7% 的已发行普通股；而 Cointelegraph 对同一批准消息的报道给出的持股比例为 93.7%。Super League 计划更名为 Superplanet 并启用纳斯达克代码 SUPA，拟主要通过高级非 convertible 永续优先股而非债务为后续比特币购买融资，Metaplanet 另拥有最多 2.1 亿美元初级优先股的投资选择权；Metaplanet 所持普通股设有五年锁定期。
current_state.en: Super League shareholders approved a deal giving Metaplanet a 93.7% stake through a 2,100 BTC and $2.5 million contribution, creating a Nasdaq-listed Bitcoin treasury company with access to US capital markets.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Metaplanet won shareholder approval to take ~95.7% control of Nasdaq-listed Super League Enterprise by injecting 2,100 BTC and $2.5M cash (~$134.6M total), establishing a US-listed Bitcoin treasury platform alongside its Japanese operations.
updates.background_zh: 该交易依据涉及 Metaplanet 与 Evo Fund 的协议获批，涵盖最多 4.359 亿股普通股的发行。Metaplanet 已累计持有约 44,000 枚比特币，是仅次于 Strategy 的第二大公开上市企业比特币持有者，并于本月早些时候提议将最多 15% 的总资产配置于战略投资。在 10 月 15 日的 SEC 文件中，Super League 表示由比特币财库公司发行的优先证券在美国的市场规模已足以容纳新进入者。
updates.background_en: The transaction was approved under agreements involving Metaplanet and Evo Fund, covering the issuance of as many as 435.9 million common shares. Metaplanet has accumulated about 44,000 BTC, making it the second-largest publicly traded corporate Bitcoin holder behind Strategy, and earlier this month proposed allocating up to 15% of total assets to strategic investments. In an Oct. 15 SEC filing, Super League said the US market for preferred securities issued by Bitcoin treasury companies has grown large enough to support new entrants.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该交易为企业增持比特币增加了一个新的美国上市载体，Superplanet 的优先股结构可能为比特币财库策略引入美元资本，与 Metaplanet 现有的日元融资形成互补。这同时使 SLE/SUPA 股票与 Metaplanet 日本上市股票的走势更紧密地绑定于比特币财库叙事，为美国投资者提供了直接参与该策略的股票通道。
updates.market_impact_en: The deal adds a new US-listed vehicle for corporate Bitcoin accumulation, with Superplanet's preferred-stock structure potentially drawing dollar-denominated capital into BTC treasury strategies alongside Metaplanet's existing yen financing. It also ties the fate of SLE/SUPA shares and Metaplanet's Japanese listing more tightly to Bitcoin treasury sentiment, giving US investors a direct equity channel into that strategy.
